what_happened: Arm B run 1 executed all five LLM stages successfully, then failed at the freeze step because the Judge wrote prose into uncertainty.repeatability.value, which schemas/agent_recommendation.schema.json requires to be number|null.
classification: harness/schema-contract bug, not an Agent scientific decision
fix: scripts/run_scientific_agent_v3.py::normalize_judge_output() moves non-numeric content into the adjacent note/detail field and nulls the numeric slot. No prompt, evidence, candidate or selection logic was changed.
why_the_series_was_restarted: The fix was applied BEFORE any blind recommendation was successfully frozen, so no recommendation existed that could have been tuned against. This directory is retained as evidence of that sequence.
